dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smooth concave spline curvature on the trailing edge, exhibiting moderate falcation from the basal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute or hooked terminal features.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, nearly linear incline of approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal base axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height to base width ratio of approximately 2.3:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial light-colored linear marks and textural irregularities visible at the posterior base of the fin; minor irregularities along the distal portion of the trailing edge.
